method: Read the paper and write TALK-PLAN.md before rewriting; explain the operation and a concrete example before notation, then follow the intermediate steps.
scope: All 50 page summaries and 635 original explanatory paragraphs rewritten, with section leads and equation notes revised. Visual assets, tables, displayed mathematics, anchors, and interactive behavior preserved.

checks: division replay over seven small prime fields

limitations: This exposition review does not independently reproduce the authors internal compiler, decoder simulations, or complete physical estimate.
